verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has a first-party OpenFeature docs page stating that switching to or from GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not any flag calls. That directly addresses the vendor lock-in concern for flag code. Missing for 10: which languages or SDKs have OpenFeature providers and how mature they are, which OpenFeature features are supported (hooks, events, evaluation context mapping), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
